messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — change window tomorrow 03:00-07:00 UTC. Need a last-pass freeze/readiness checklist.
Jon S: Thanks — can we confirm code freeze at 00:00 UTC and cutoff for PRs is 22:00 today?
Maya R: Yup, code freeze 00:00 UTC. PRs after 22:00 require explicit approval from release lead.
Amir K: I'll own release notes and model pinning. Planning to pin embeddings model to `redwood-embed@v2.1.0` and generation model to `gptx-3.2-pin1`.
Lucy O: I'll own infra runbook and rollback window. I'll post rollback commands in the runbook.
Jon S: Canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation windows. If latency or errors spike, abort and rollback to previous pin.
Emma P: Dashboard links: Console->Routes /api/generate and Console->Model-pins added to the release checklist doc.
DeployBot: Reminder: scheduled change window starts in 19h. Please ensure service accounts have the right tokens. :robot_face:
Maya R: Required sanity checks: health endpoint ok, 95th pct latency within SLO, token usage under threshold, no regressions on our smoke prompts.
Amir K: Smoke prompting checklist (I'll run): 10 quick prompts for hallucination/regression tests, embeddings similarity sanity, and a small eval set for reranking.
Lucy O: Infra checklist: reserve Dedicated capacity for the window, validate autoscaler policy, confirm network ACLs for private deploys, snapshot DB before migration.
Jon S: Migrations: no destructive migrations in this window. If any schema change is needed, we schedule migration in a separate maintenance slot.
Maya R: Rollback decision criteria (short): error rate >3x baseline for 10m OR lat p95 > 2x SLO OR critical feature regressions flagged by QA. If triggered, immediate rollback + status page.
Lucy O: Rollback commands (keeps it short):
```
# rollback to previous deployment revision
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api-service --namespace=prod
# revert model pin via control plane
redwoodctl models pin set api/generation --version=gptx-3.1-stable
```
Amir K: Release notes draft pushed to /docs/release-notes/1765012345.md — includes model pins, known limitations, and observability deltas. Ping me for edits.
Emma P: I updated change-window channel topic and added postmortem owner placeholders. Also added a doc link to the QA smoke results.
Jon S: Feature flags: ensure new features disabled by default and gated behind `ff_release_1765`. Ops can flip after 100% rollout if all checks green.
Maya R: Approvals: @Jon S (release lead), @Lucy O (infra), @Amir K (ML), @Emma P (QA). Please react with :thumbsup: when you're good.
Jon S: :thumbsup:
Lucy O: :thumbsup:
Amir K: :thumbsup:
Emma P: :thumbsup:
ReleaseBot: Release checklist updated by Amir K — all items timestamped 1765012400.
DeployBot: Canary started — 5% traffic routing to gptx-3.2-pin1 at 1765012560. Monitoring windows active. :rocket:
Maya R: Thanks everyone — I'll monitor the channel through the window and post status updates. If anything urgent, call me directly.
